elle.design: Quick A11y check — noticed the new model-run panel steals focus when results stream in. UX feels jarring for keyboard users. Thoughts? kevin.eng: Yea saw that. We move focus to the results container because of the live updates, but agree it's noisy. maya.a11y: Can we avoid forcing focus? Recommend leaving focus where the user was and using an aria-live region for announcements instead. Use aria-live="polite" so screen readers don't interrupt typing. sam.pm: Does that mean keyboard users won't be taken to the result? We want them to know new content arrived but not lose their spot. kevin.eng: Right — idea: show a small inline toast in the results header that is focusable (tabstop) so users can opt-in to jump. Default behavior: no programmatic focus. elle.design: I like the opt-in pattern. Visual affordance should be high contrast and keyboard reachable. Also need to ensure focus styles pass contrast. maya.a11y: UX + a11y checklist proposal: - No automatic focus moves unless user action. - Global aria-live region for non-interruptive announcements (polite). - Provide a focusable "Jump to results" button with clear screen reader label. - Ensure :focus-visible ring meets 3:1 contrast against background and uses token colors. kevin.eng: Will prototype. Quick CSS example for the button focus ring:```css .jump-to-results:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent-600); /* ensure contrast */ outline-offset: 2px; } ``` maya.a11y: For the live region we should use a single offscreen container so we avoid repeated DOM nodes getting announced. Example:```html
``` When new results stream, populate with: `New results available: 3 items. Press Jump to results to go.` elle.design: Small copy tweak: avoid wordy announcements. Maybe: `3 new results — press J to jump` (we'll decide on accessibility-key hint later). sam.pm: Shortcut idea: support `J` for jumping but needs discoverability. Add hint in the toast and a11y shortcut docs. kevin.eng: Implementation question: we have streaming partial items; should we debounce announcements to avoid spam? maya.a11y: Yes — debounce to ~700ms after the last streamed item and only announce a summarized message. Otherwise NVDA/VoiceOver will cascade reads. elle.design: Also noticed contrast issue on the current toast background when in dark mode — the label uses token `text-muted` which falls below 4.5:1 on our bg. Needs darker text or lighter bg. kevin.eng: I'll update token to `text-normal` or bump bg. Which do you prefer? maya.a11y: Prefer using `text-normal` on the same bg so other toasts remain consistent. Confirm in both high-contrast and WCAG themes. aria-bot: Accessibility checklist updated: live-region-debounce, jump-button-focusable, focus-visible-contrast, toast-copy-short, keyboard-shortcut-docs. :white_check_mark: sam.pm: Quick test plan: NVDA + Firefox, VoiceOver + Safari, KVM keyboard only walkthrough, and keyboard only with a sample long-run streaming. Put testing notes in the PR template. kevin.eng: Will open a draft PR with prototype and test notes tonight. Tagging @maya.a11y and @elle.design for review. elle.design: Thanks — small nit: when the Jump button is focused, ensure it has an aria-label that includes the count, e.g., `Jump to results (3)` so SR users get context. maya.a11y: Agree. Also add `aria-pressed` state if the button toggles a pinned view. kevin.eng: Got it. I'll post the PR link here when ready. elle.design: :thumbsup:
